correctness.rationale: The feasible quotient coordinates form exactly the interval [max(-1,2(r-b)),min(2r,2a-1)]; only cross-part jumps can strictly improve and each moves one unit. The exact utility differences on the two alternating edge types reverse sign when reversed, so their sign antiderivative strictly increases by one on every improving move. Its range gives the all-size move bound and local extrema classify every equilibrium. Counting labeled positions, agents and vacancy yields the closed formula. Independently evaluated exact-rational checks passed 719520 individual moves in 600 instances; these do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The infinite topology family admits a uniform all-utility termination theorem and complete exact equilibrium counts in a domain where general jump Schelling improvement cycles are known; this identifies the structural boundary supplied by a one-dimensional vacancy/count quotient.
